nodes.label: Confidence before installation

nodes.label: Unaided developer completion gate

nodes.label: Component memory for builders

nodes.label: Observed structure versus inferred behavior

nodes.label: Faithful styling isolation
nodes.rationale: Source styling remains inside an iframe instead of inheriting destination branding; fit scores do not establish visual equivalence.

nodes.label: Contextual preview workspace
nodes.rationale: The canvas stays central while controls and evidence stay near the user action.

nodes.label: Explainable project-fit score
nodes.rationale: Source-based framework, theme, action, accessibility and size evidence describe adaptation work rather than runtime correctness.

nodes.label: Historical verification boundaries
nodes.rationale: Later dated results supersede older snapshots; native runtime and public hosting claims remain separate from local web checks.

nodes.label: Local durable contact receipts
nodes.rationale: Forms validate and store local requests; this is not email delivery or reconstruction of private backend behavior.

nodes.label: Documented shortcut limits
nodes.rationale: A shortcut comment records its known limit and the condition for upgrading it, keeping deferred work explicit.

nodes.label: Smallest complete change
nodes.rationale: Minimize new code by reusing existing patterns, platform features, and installed dependencies while completing every affected caller, test, fixture, configuration, and export.

nodes.label: Preserve validation and error handling
nodes.rationale: Small changes must still protect trust boundaries, data, security, accessibility, and hardware calibration; non-trivial logic needs a small test or assert-based self-check.

nodes.label: Evidence comparison and reconstruction verification
nodes.rationale: Equivalence claims require complete compatible page sets; static differences and matching patterns are hypotheses rather than causal proof, and reconstruction passes cover only declared comparable claims.

nodes.label: Coverage and unresolved unknowns
nodes.rationale: Exhausting retained pages does not establish complete source or program coverage; absence and resolution claims need qualifying observed evidence and explicit remaining authority requirements.

nodes.label: Retained analysis views
nodes.rationale: Reuse complete retained Evidence through inspect_analysis_view for summaries or selected pages rather than repeating the evidence producer.

nodes.label: Guarded source installation and undo

nodes.label: Optimistic versions and idempotent writes
